We hold these truths. All men are created equal. Their Creator gives them rights, and no one can take these rights away. Among them are Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness. Governments exist to secure these rights. They get their power from the people, and only from the people. When a Government works against these rights, the people can change it. They can tear it down and build another. They can found it on whatever principles, and shape it into whatever form, seems likely to bring them safety and happiness.

A government that has stood a long time should not be changed for small reasons. This is what prudence teaches. And history shows the same thing. Men will suffer. They will bear evils as long as the evils can be borne. They would rather suffer than rise up and abolish the government they know. But there is a point past that. When a government commits one abuse after another, always toward the same end, and the end is clear, and the end is to put men under absolute Despotism, then men have a right. They have a duty. They must throw off such a Government. They must build new Guards for their future security.
